collection.credit:
ISOLA — BEYOND THE HORIZON: THE WORLD WE IMAGINE
A NEW, SEPARATE COMPANION EVENT ANTHOLOGY FOR VIRTUAL VILLAGERS 1–5
Version 1.0 | 40 original branching events
collection.description: As the sun sets, a child asks whether someone on a distant shore might be wondering about the islanders.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: As the sun sets, a child asks whether someone on a distant shore might be wondering about the lives of unknown islanders at this very moment.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The child invents a distant scholar asking whether Isolans build houses, sing songs, and care for their families.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: An elder laughs at the thought of strangers imagining every Isolan as a fearless explorer.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The villagers list things outsiders might assume incorrectly about their knowledge, beliefs, and daily lives.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A young craftsperson worries that an outsider might admire the island but fail to listen to its people.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: They compose a hypothetical greeting: "We work, learn, disagree, love, and wonder. What about you?"

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The child decides that perhaps no one is wondering about them - and that their lives still matter just as much.
